info.name: W3DS Connector
info.summary: Connect Nextcloud to W3DS for passwordless login and Talk sync
info.description:
Connect Nextcloud to the W3DS decentralized identity ecosystem for passwordless authentication and optional bidirectional sync of Nextcloud Talk conversations to and from users' eVaults.
Users authenticate by scanning a QR code with their eID wallet, which signs a session challenge using ECDSA P-256. No passwords are transmitted or stored.
Once a user has linked their W3DS identity, their Talk rooms and messages are mirrored to their eVault, so the same conversations are available on any other W3DS-connected platform. Login works with or without Nextcloud Talk installed.
Authentication: - QR code login on the Nextcloud login page - Auto-provisioning of new users on first authentication - Display name, email and avatar hydrated from the user's eVault profile - Link and unlink a W3DS identity from personal settings - Signature verification via the W3DS Registry
Talk chat sync (requires Nextcloud Talk): - Rooms and messages synced in both directions - File and image attachments - @ mentions translated between Talk and W3DS identities - W3DS users discoverable in the share picker and from inside a room
